content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICMR NIRWOH Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICMR NIRWOH Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women's Health (ICMR NIRWOH) for hiring temporary research staff.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under ICMR NIRWOH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Dietician and Data Entry Operator, with a total of 2 vacancies open for eligible and qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Walk-in. Candidates do not need to submit any online or offline application forms in advance unless specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 09 October 2026 at the designated address in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Dietician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in science/relevant subjects like nutrition or applied nutrition with 5 years experience, or a Master's degree in relevant subjects.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: Applicants must be Intermediate or 12th Pass in the Science stream with a DOEACC A Level or 2 years of relevant experience in EDP work.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Dietician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Dietician position is set at 30 years as per the recruitment guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Data Entry Operator position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 25,168/-.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Bone Health Clinic, 18 A Old BDD Chawl, Room Nos 8,9,10,14 Ground Floor, Dadar East, Mumbai 400012.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee is required or mentioned in the official notification for attending the walk-in selection process.
